name: After annex I; Regulation (EU) 2023/956 – Annex II
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2023/956 as regards the extension of its scope to downstream goods and anti-circumvention measures
part_text: In point 1 of ANNEX II, in the table ‘Iron and Steel’ the following exception is added: ex 720241 Ferrochromium, containing by weight > 4% of carbon ex 720249 Ferrochromium containing by weight <= 4% of carbon Greenhouse gas Carbon dioxide
